_comment: Lint fixture for CCV-L12, which is a cross-file rule and so cannot be
counter-exampled by a SystemVerilog file alone. tools/check-1d.sh points
the rule at this schema instead of the real one.
Two violations: an interface with no checker module at all, and a control
field the existing checker does not reference.

interfaces.name: issue_t
interfaces.doc: CCV-L12: adds a control field the real checker never references.

fields.name: never_checked_field
fields.doc: CCV-L12: a control field added to the struct and not to the checker.
